entries.zh: 庵婆：庵堂中供奉神佛、司香火的老妇；女祭师、女巫（西语释为“女祭司”）
entries.en: priestess (female sacrificer); old woman attendant of a nunnery or shrine
entries.notes: 官话栏对音存疑（com/cons），据汉字“庵婆”与西语“女祭司”拟定

entries.zh: 包：袋子、包裹；包扎、装包（西语释为“袋与囊”）
entries.en: bag, sack; bundle, parcel; to wrap up

entries.zh: 布袋：盛放行粮、行李杂物的粗布口袋
entries.en: cloth sack; sack for provisions or victuals, hold-all bag
entries.notes: 西语栏多行粘连并含未展开缩写（abq），据 matalotage（行粮）与汉字“布袋”拟定

entries.zh: 祭：祭祀、祭献（对神明祖先行祭）
entries.en: to sacrifice; to offer sacrifice or oblation

entries.zh: 醮：设醮——道教设坛祭神的醮礼
entries.en: to hold a Taoist offering rite (jiao); sacrificial libation to the gods

entries.zh: 牙：做牙——商家每月初二、十六例祭土地公之祀（头牙、尾牙属此）
entries.en: ya: bimonthly offering to the Earth God on the 2nd and 16th of the month (zuoya, merchants' regular sacrifice)

entries.zh: 供养：以香花饮食供献神佛；泛指供奉、赡养
entries.en: to make offerings (to gods or Buddhas); to provide for, support
entries.notes: 闽南栏污损难辨（T99）且拼写存疑，据汉字“供养”与西语释义拟定

entries.en: to sacrifice and offer up; sacrificial offering

entries.zh: 祭祀：依礼祭祀神明与祖先
entries.en: to perform sacrificial rites; sacrifice to gods and ancestors

entries.zh: 道场：僧道设坛诵经祭神之法事（做道场）；亦指法事坛场
entries.en: taochang: ritual ceremony of altar, prayers and sacrifice performed by priests; ritual ground
entries.notes: 西语 recando 语义不明（疑为 rezando 之讹），闽南栏亦存疑（to tio/jo tio），以汉字“道场”为主

entries.zh: 祭葬：为死者设祭安葬之礼（丧葬之祭）
entries.en: to sacrifice for and bury the dead; funerary sacrifice

entries.zh: 祝愿：在家中神像前祝祷许愿
entries.en: to vow and pray before the household idol; votive prayer
entries.notes: 第二字泐损存疑（愆/愿），闽南音 guan 合于“愿”，定为家中神前祝祷许愿

entries.zh: 下祝：在自家神像前设供行祝、下供祝祷
entries.en: to set out offerings and pray before the household idol

entries.zh: 稷：五谷之神（天子岁祭之谷神，社稷之“稷”）
entries.en: ji: the grain god (millet deity) to whom the king offers sacrifice
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（a[残] y tierra），据“稷”为谷神、王者祭稷之典拟定

entries.zh: 社稷：土神与谷神，天子岁祭；引申指国家社稷
entries.en: sheji: gods of soil and grain; the state altars (by extension, the state itself)
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（ide[残]），据“社稷”土谷之祭与王者祭典拟定

entries.zh: 郊天：天子郊祀祭天之礼
entries.en: jiaotian: the imperial suburban sacrifice to Heaven offered by the king
entries.notes: 西语栏结尾 ides 语义不明（疑缩写或讹写），据“郊天”与王者祭天语境拟定

entries.zh: 丧礼：为亡者所设丧葬祭奠之礼
entries.en: funeral rites; sacrifice offered for the dead
entries.notes: 闽南栏首音污损难辨（T99），据汉字“丧礼”与西语“为亡者献祭”拟定

entries.zh: 郎君会：奉祀郎君爷的祀神会社，会众轮值供奉神像香火（司奉偶像者）
entries.en: Langjun hui: lay confraternity that keeps and serves the deity's idol (the 'sacristans of the idol' as a body)
